messages:
sam_oncall: Noticed increased duplicate pages from the cache layer this morning (01:12-01:40 UTC). Opening a short follow-up to assign owners and timeline.

nina_dev: I dug in - cache flushes during deploy plus multiple exporters led to the same alert keyed by instance. Rule is per-instance so we got N pages. I can take a quick relabel + suppression PR.

joel_sre: Can you paste the alert (sanitized)? want to check grouping and for=.

nina_dev: Rule (sanitized):
```yaml
alert: CacheMissBurst
expr: increase(cache_miss_total[2m]) / increase(cache_requests_total[2m]) > 0.1
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: page
  team: caching
```
We eval every 1m.

joel_sre: Short fixes: 1) collapse to service-level grouping (sum by service) 2) increase for: to 5m or add warn->page path 3) add suppression window in Alertmanager (5-10m) for matching fingerprints.

tess_pm: Timeline: customers getting paged overnight. Need quick fix today + robust fix next week. Also track recurrence so we can report.

nina_dev: I'll open a small PR to apply relabel_config to drop instance label for this metric and add a 5m mute rule in Alertmanager for matching fingerprints. Test in staging tonight.

joel_sre: I'll update the runbook: add recurrence tag and a metric incidents.recurring{alert=CacheMissBurst}. Also draft a backpressure playbook (how to detect storm, thresholds, manual override).

alert-bot: Incident created INC-2256-cache-noise. Owners: nina_dev (relabel + PR), joel_sre (runbook + playbook), tess_pm (customer comms). Due: 2024-07-02.

tess_pm: Action items recap:
- nina_dev: PR + staging smoke tests (due 2024-06-28)
- joel_sre: runbook update + recurrence metric + dashboard tile (due 2024-06-30)
- sam_oncall: verify postdeploy paging delta + schedule 15m follow-up (due 2024-06-29)

nina_dev: Smoke test plan: emit synthetic cache spike from 3 instances for 120s, expect single service-level alert or warn only. Rollback via config revert.

joel_sre: Add safety escalation: if total cache miss rate across service > 25% then immediate page bypassing suppression. We'll include fingerprinting guidance (use service+cluster).

tess_pm: We'll aim for >90% reduction in duplicate pages for this alert and include weekly recurrence reporting.

sam_oncall: Scheduling 20m sync tomorrow 11:00 UTC to review PR and acceptance criteria. Please add subtasks to the incident ticket.

nina_dev: taking the relabel PR.

joel_sre: taking runbook/playbook.

alert-bot: Follow-up reminder set for 2024-07-03 09:00 UTC.

tess_pm: Thanks all. Add any extra steps to the incident so we can track in the postmortem dashboard. :memo:
